description: dispatcher for Toyota's mechanic: runs adws/adw_toyota_mechanic.py and relays the outcome line it printed
notes: Migrated out of finance_team/roles.py; this folder is now the definition and extra_roles.py loads it. model is null on purpose: like every routed role it runs on Toyota's --role-model. The coder that actually edits code is the separate mechanic_coder folder, whose model is pinned in its own model.json. Both folders are in adws/adw_toyota_mechanic_guard.py's PROTECTED list, so a mechanic run cannot rewrite either.
